hardware.variant: Luckfox Lyra Zero W with 512 MiB DDR3 and 256 MiB Winbond SPI NAND.

scenario: Leave the microSD slot empty. Capture UART0. Press RESET with BOOT released. Read the log through the vendor login prompt.
expected: Identify the loader, the selected boot medium, the board model and the USB radio detected by the factory system.
observed: SPL tried MMC1, reported an initialization error and tried MTD1. U-Boot reported mtd 1. Linux identified the Luckfox Lyra Zero W and 256 MiB Winbond SPI NAND. DWC2 enumerated a hub and a downstream USB device. The factory Wi-Fi service selected AIC8800DC (a69c:88dc), reported successful initialization and reached the login prompt.
limits: The observation covers one reset with an empty microSD slot. The board revision was not read.
An EmberBSD boot, selection of an inserted card, Wi-Fi association and a network login require separate tests.
